top.line: A persona for someone who cannot go public, vouched for in the web of trust, reachable sealed.

in-short.line: A persona, vouchers who countersign, kinds of link, credibility, sealed contact, triangulation.

situation.line: Someone needs to leave but cannot go public; a persona shows their depth without their name.

missing.line: Trust and contact: the persona has its own key; public people link to it; employers write sealed.

kinds.line: Real, known, worked with, vouch to hire: typed links, each countersigned.

credibility.line: Many vouchers across disciplines, and credible ones, make an anonymous profile believable.

public.line: Vouching for Vicky Wang as a signed, checkable link instead of a soft recommendation.

reveal.line: The person reveals themselves to one employer only, by a sealed signed link.

triangulation.line: Vouchers in common can identify someone; an agent tests for it before publishing.

limits.line: A proposal; anonymity not guaranteed; link kinds to be added.

sources.line: My thinking on 21 November 2026; the person is not named.
